title: Authored learning module
description: Envelope around one LearningModuleDefinition. The `module` property is byte-for-byte the shape declared in apps/web/src/module/moduleFormat.ts, so a consumer does JSON.parse(file).module and casts. Everything else in the envelope is authoring evidence — reading-rate arithmetic, deliberate exclusions, the window re-cut against Mission-Slate §4.7 — and no runtime reads it.

card.description: One screen. `throughSeconds` is where this card's presentation target ENDS, measured from module start; the format cannot express a minimum dwell, so no author can turn a target into a lock-out. The last card's value is the whole module length and must be 180.

excerpt.description: A quoted primary source. Verbatim always; runtime never generates or paraphrases one.

conceptIds.description: Empty on a frame card, which teaches none and says so rather than being absent from a list.

codexCardIds.description: Propositions this card is the sole source for. This is the field that makes the duel's answerable-from-the-module claim checkable rather than asserted.
